method.downstream: The acquisition worker result and trace belong to the corresponding generation. The original branch stopped at pixel_bootstrap. The candidate produced independent initial, current V2 and servo targets, with returned frame ID, checksum and selected ID recorded in online_chain. The replay never emits a target on behalf of either worker.
method.exact_pixel_set_hash: SHA256 of row-major ordered coordinate pairs encoded as compact ASCII JSON.
method.margin: Optical depth minus that frame's maximum selected top depth minus twice the bound, in metres. The bound is zero in all 12 frames. Every ring pixel must be valid, finite and strictly positive in this margin.
method.pixel_coordinates: rc is zero-based row, column; target/destination xy are in column, row order.
method.replay: Each sealed source tree independently validated its effective registration and asset, decoded its own original full RGB-D, projected the current marker-derived object, and executed the frozen target and destination inspection. Read-only tracing at the original target geometry return exposed its final red mask, shaded edge, ring and raw depths.

scope: Development-only offline readback of six original v1 and six actual v2 bootstrap packets
